# Append-only agent image field inventory (TestImageFieldInventoryAppendOnly).
# One line per exported field of every named struct reachable from agentimage.Bundle:
#   pkg.Type.Field<TAB>struct tag<TAB>Go type
# Entries may be ADDED by -update-image-inventory; removing or editing one is an image
# epoch decision (architecture §22.5) and must be done by hand with a commit-message
# justification. Within an epoch the image schema only grows, with omitempty fields.
